channel.title: Four of Hearts Interactive News
channel.description: Company and game news from Four of Hearts Interactive.

item.title: Introducing GildenSpire: Flight or Fight
item.description: Raise a dragon, take direct control in the sky, and discover what happens when flying becomes fighting.

item.title: Why Flying Has to Be Fun
item.description: The journey should be gameplay: direct flight, enormous terrain, curiosity, and combat that rewards control.

item.title: Building Dragons That Actually Feel Different
item.description: GildenSpire dragons are being designed as different creatures—not one model wearing different colors.

item.title: Introducing Thumb Command: Save Planet Earth
item.description: Meet Blueguard and the worldwide arcade-defense campaign taking shape at Four of Hearts Interactive.

item.title: Meet Sleep Amigo
item.description: A private, calm sleep companion joins the Four of Hearts lifestyle application line.

item.title: People Lens Joins the Lifestyle Line
item.description: A people-search utility concept extends the studio beyond games.

item.title: Building Unicorn Land Adventures
item.description: Unicorn creation, magical habitats, decorating, discovery, and mini-games define a distinct creative game.

item.title: Inside Princess Land Adventures
item.description: Character style, castle rooms, cooking, decorating, and mini-games begin forming one creative game.

item.title: HeartStack Unicorn Blast Joins the Workbench
item.description: A first look at colourful combos, crystal cages, boosters, and unicorn rescue.

item.title: Evil Doom Boy: Two Heroes, One Fight
item.description: Evil Doom Boy is one action-adventure game with Evil Doom Boy as the default hero and Evil Doom Girl as the alternate hero.

item.title: Bobby and the Breadstone
item.description: Bread-powered towers, branching paths, cheerful enemies, and one heroic dinosaur define Bobby’s direction.

item.title: The 4OH Card Table Adds Solitaire and War
item.description: Two familiar card games join Palace, Hearts, Spades, and Euchre in the Four of Hearts lineup.

item.title: Palace 0.1.9 Enters Founder Review
item.description: The flagship card-table build advances through hands-on founder testing.
